file_roles.evidence: Diff adds `resultSet.bindUntypedNullsToResultColumns(null)` in SubqueryNode.bindExpression so untyped NULL is rejected at bind time instead of NPE in setDataTypeServices.

rationale: The NPE is at SubqueryNode.setDataTypeServices called from bindExpression. The fix adds the missing untyped-null check inside SubqueryNode.bindExpression. SubqueryNode owns binding of its own result columns, so the missing check is the defect.
